gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-voces: Voces stands up tall and tidy, its lowercase built to reach, with strokes that barely vary. Voces sans lets Wallpoet's bold, see-through lines take the spotlight while it quietly holds the text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-winky-sans: Thin gaps where the paper shows through every Wallpoet letter give it a stencil-like punch. And Winky Sans, a plain sans with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, keeps the whole thing modern and easygoing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-yantramanav: Loud meets tidy here, with Wallpoet's bold, commanding letters running smooth around every bend. Yantramanav sans does the opposite job, huddling its tall lowercase close, with open curve endings that keep text moving.
gen-gf-wallpoet-outfit: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, its lowercase rising high and its lines split to let the paper through. But Outfit, a plain sans bent like cable, brings a moderate lowercase and curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-plus-jakarta-sans: Lines that break open to show the paper behind them make Wallpoet instantly recognizable, and it excels at big, loud statements. Plus Jakarta Sans, a plain sans of monoline strokes with well-parted curve endings, does the precise, modern work of carrying text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-sora: Wallpoet comes in loud, with high lowercase and smooth bends, best when it gets to be bold. Sora is wire-like and geometric, best at precise sans-serif text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-space-grotesk: Commanding and bold, Wallpoet rises high with see-through lines. Space Grotesk, a sans-serif cut from one flat ribbon of constant width, gives it a geometric counterweight that is its best single trait.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-amulya: Ink strokes that taper out before they touch make Warnes unmistakable, spaced wide and stripped of any thick-thin contrast. And Amulya, a contemporary sans-serif with generous curve gaps and moderate lowercase height, would carry a long read smoothly.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-chillax: Stretched out and inky, Warnes tapers every stroke to a point and holds a flat, expressive weight with high lowercase. Chillax, a sans-serif of spaghetti-loose lines, handles the relaxed text.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-plein: Wide-spaced and expressive, Warnes lets its ink strokes taper away with no contrast at all, and its lowercase rises high. Plein, a clean sans-serif with a clear channel into each round letter, does the dependable text work.
